integrity: The universal claim is proved symbolically from the Cauchy--Binet chart identity, the derivative of a determinant, and an explicit fibration of each exact radical stratum over an orthogonal Grassmannian. Finite symbolic checks are used only as consistency tests and are not treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complex Grassmannians equipped with a nondegenerate symmetric bilinear form.
It does not compute degrees, component structure in maximal-isotropic boundary cases, or scheme-theoretic multiplicities of the radical degeneracy loci.
Exact codimension three does not by itself improve the initiating source's universal model-dimension obstruction for ED-generality.
Older orthogonal-degeneracy literature may contain an equivalent global radical-stratum formula under different terminology.
title: A universal codimension-three singular locus for the Grassmannian isotropic quadric
